question: Does a decoupling-before-aggregation hierarchical retrieval layer (xMemory-style: episode -> semantic component -> theme, revisable grouping, top-down complementary selection expanding only when uncertainty reduces) over the existing SPIDER mechanism registry improve alias-OOD retrieval complementarity vs flat top-k RAG (k=5 cosine) and vs verbatim replay on the same synthetic orthogonal header/body/auth alias-OOD splits that Frontier already validated (40 pooled, 30 orthogonal, 10 mixed, 9 held-out) - measured by alias-OOD correct>=0.50 (binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10, McNemar p<0.05 vs exact matcher), false_accept<=0.15, UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, ECE<=0.15, plus retrieval complementarity gain coverage>=0.15 and evidence density, with trajectory-grouped bootstrap CIs, without requiring new BrowserGym 1280x720 SPAs, and does it preserve exact-match>=0.90 no-regression?
hypothesis: A decoupling-before-aggregation hierarchical retrieval layer (xMemory episodic -> semantic component -> theme: mechanisms as episodes, parsed components by header-key/body-field/auth-scope/url-segment, themes as header/body/auth/mixed groups, revisable grouping via component overlap, top-down complementary selection expanding only when theme-level entropy/uncertainty reduces) over the existing SPIDER mechanism registry will improve alias-OOD retrieval complementarity and downstream resolution vs flat top-5 RAG (k=5 cosine TFIDF and all-MiniLM-L6-v2) and vs verbatim replay on the same synthetic orthogonal header/body/auth alias-OOD splits (40 pooled =30 orthogonal +10 mixed, per-family 10 each, held-out 9, plus 12 exact, 12 no-applicable, 6 empty =70 tasks per method) without requiring new BrowserGym 1280x720 SPAs. When coupled with the same genuine non-oracle reconstruction (choose_adoptions + rewrite_template_multi, softmax temp 0.15 + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80, derived_context only url/method/url_path/url_query/url_segments/headers_observed/body_observed), hierarchical retrieval will achieve: pooled alias-OOD correct>=0.50 with binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 and McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH (0/40 expected), orthogonal subset >=0.50, mixed subset >=0.40, false_accept<=0.15 and >=0.15 below verbatim (McNemar p<0.05), UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, ECE<=0.15 (5 bins, bootstrap 2000), while improving retrieval complementarity coverage gain >=0.15 (hierarchical recall@k minus best flat recall@k on alias-OOD) and evidence density (distinct semantic components per retrieved set) vs flat, and preserving exact-match>=0.90 no-regression. Flat top-k similarity collapses on bounded coherent streams with near-duplicate intents (held-equal intents isolate aliasing) -> 0/40 recall, so hierarchical theme-diversity selection is predicted to provide the missing complementarity that reconstruction alone cannot leverage if retrieval is homogeneous.
falsifier: Controls PASS required for any SURVIVES/FALSIFIES. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC-EXACT-MATCH fails (B-EXACT-MATCH or hierarchical+reconstruction exact correct <0.90 or false>0.10), NC-NO-APPLICABLE fails (UNKNOWN precision<0.90 or false>0.10), NC-EMPTY fails (not 100% UNKNOWN), NC-ORACLE-LEAK detected (derived_context contains forbidden keys alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix/target_style/path_style/header_key/body_field/auth_scope/expected_template or hierarchical indexer reads hidden_expected or uses test template verbatim, or confidence hardcoded std<=0.05), pooled N<32, >20% harness errors, registry leak >0/40, or retrieval returns empty on >50% of alias-OOD (retrieval substrate invalid). SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff ALL hold: (S1) hierarchical+reconstruction pooled correct>=0.50 with binomial one-sided p<0.05 vs 0.10 and McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH and orthogonal >=0.50 and mixed >=0.40 and held-out 9/9 >=0.50 diagnostic; (S2) false_accept<=0.15 and >=0.15 below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY with McNemar p<0.05; (S3) exact-match correct>=0.90 (hierarchical) and no >0.10 regression vs B-EXACT-MATCH on exact stratum; (S4) no-applicable UNKNOWN precision>=0.85 and ECE<=0.15 (5 bins, derived confidence) with bootstrap CI; (S5) not dominated by retrieval: hierarchical pooled correct not >0.10 below best flat RAG pooled correct (if both 0, tie passes but complementarity must be tested); (S6 COMPLEMENTARITY) retrieval coverage gain >=0.15 absolute (hierarchical recall@k - best flat recall@k on pooled alias-OOD, recall = retrieved set contains at least one mechanism with correct alias-family component that reconstruction can adopt) with trajectory-grouped block bootstrap 2000 p<0.05, and evidence density gain >0 (hierarchical mean distinct components per retrieved set > flat mean, bootstrap p<0.05). FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls pass but S1 fails (pooled <0.40 or not above exact p>=0.05 or orthogonal<0.40 or mixed<0.30 with pooled<0.50) or S2 fails (false>0.25 or not below verbatim) or S6 fails (coverage gain <0.05 and not significant) when hierarchical does not improve over flat despite passing PC/NC - bounded to genuine hierarchical vs flat on tested orthogonal/mixed synthetic with minimal derived dict. FALSIFIED complementarity without invalidating reconstruction ceiling: prior 40/40 rule-based reconstruction ceiling with oracle-free retrieval (exact-intent scan) remains bounded SURVIVES for reconstruction; hierarchical falsification only closes hierarchical retrieval variant.
baselines: B-EXACT-MATCH (current SPIDER kernel): SpiderKernel.resolve with L97 exact intent equality, min_confidence 0.8, candidates sorted by confidence. No retrieval diversity. Prior 0/40 alias-OOD pooled, 12/12 exact. Tests whether any retrieval adds value. ID B-EXACT-MATCH.

B-VERBATIM-REPLAY: Scan registry in insertion order, retrieve top-1 by exact intent equality, replay stored action_template verbatim via _bind without critique/rewriting. Aborts only if required_slots missing. Measures negative-transfer harm. Prior false_accept 1.0 on alias-OOD. ID B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.

B-FLAT-RAG-TFIDF-K5: Flat TF-IDF retriever over mechanism intent+template strings; cosine top-k=5 then genuine reconstruction (choose_adoptions+smtp) on retrieved candidates. Fit on train registry only. Tests lexical similarity collapse when intents held equal. Prior 0/40 pooled when k=1, expected 0/40 at k=5. ID B-FLAT-RAG-TFIDF-K5.

B-FLAT-RAG-EMBED-K5 (strong retrieval): Sentence-transformer embedding cosine (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 or equivalent offline, normalized embeddings) over intent+template; top-k=5 cosine then same genuine reconstruction. If offline model unavailable, mark unavailable and use TFIDF as strong baseline with disclosure and embed encodings counted. Never uses ground-truth context signals. Prior 0/40 pooled, 220 encodings. ID B-FLAT-RAG-EMBED-K5.
B-FLAT-RAG-EMBED-K1: Same embed retriever top-k=1 then verbatim bind (no reconstruction) - ablation to separate retrieval from reconstruction. ID B-FLAT-RAG-EMBED-K1.
B-RANDOM-K5: Uniform random among registry mechanisms (intent-matched if any, else global) sample k=5 distinct then reconstruction. Chance-level retrieval diversity. ID B-RANDOM-K5.

H-HIERARCHICAL-XMEMORY-KADAPTIVE (experimental): Decoupling-before-aggregation hierarchical retrieval: Level1 episodes = individual mechanisms (with extracted semantic components: url_segments, query_keys, header_keys, body_fields, auth_scopes from template parsing, no hidden_expected), Level2 components = clustered by Jaccard overlap of component sets (revisable grouping via hierarchical agglomerative with threshold 0.6), Level3 themes = header-theme / body-theme / auth-theme / mixed-theme by majority component. Index stores theme centroids (mean TFIDF or embed of member intents+templates). Query-time top-down complementary selection: score themes by cosine/lexical relevance to derived_context+intent, select themes in rank order expanding next theme only when current selected set entropy (confidence spread) indicates uncertainty reduction (entropy delta >0.05 or coverage of distinct components not yet >=2). Adaptive k (typically 3-5 mechanisms) drawn complementarily across themes to maximize distinct component coverage, not top-k similarity alone. Then same genuine reconstruction over heterogeneous candidate set. Confidence derived from reconstruction softmax temp 0.15 + jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80; retrieval scoring is TFIDF/embed cosine aggregated at theme level, not per-mechanism verbatim leak. ID H-HIERARCHICAL-XMEMORY.

RECONSTRUCTION-RULE (reference): Genuine non-oracle structural scorer+rewriter conditioned only on (intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates) that scores slot count/path segments/query-header-body key presence and rewrites via adopt-any-observed-key-not-in-registry + rewrite_template_multi (alphabetically-sorted multi-adoption) before _bind; used identically after each retriever to isolate retrieval effect. Prior 40/40 pooled 1.0 when retrieval is exact-intent scan (oracle-free but non-diverse). ID RECONSTRUCTION-RULE (applied as downstream for all retrievers except B-VERBATIM/B-RANDOM ablations where noted).
positive_control: PC-EXACT-MATCH (ID PC-EXACT-MATCH): On exact-match stratum (N=12 tasks where test intent equals registry intent verbatim, same slot names, preconditions={}, guards={}), every retrieval+reconstruction pipeline (B-EXACT-MATCH, B-FLAT-K5+recon, H-HIERARCHICAL+recon) must achieve correct_resolution >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10 with no crashes. Verifies pipeline does not regress when no aliasing required and hierarchical grouping does not mis-route exact matches. Failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH (ID PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH): For alias-OOD pooled, hierarchical and flat retrievers must return non-empty candidate sets on >=90% of tasks and hierarchical distinct-component coverage >= flat distinct-component coverage on at least 50% of tasks (sanity that hierarchical returns diverse components). If <90% non-empty, substrate invalid -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (covers Stagehand 2x baseline comparison not applicable here). PC-HIERARCHICAL-INDEX-BUILT (ID PC-HIERARCHICAL-INDEX-BUILT): Hierarchical index must contain >=3 themes and >=6 components and episode count equals registry size (e.g., 3*7 per task group) with no hidden_expected leakage, audited via index manifest hash.
null_control: NC-NO-APPLICABLE (ID NC-NO-APPLICABLE): On no-applicable stratum (N=12 tasks where test intent is OOD with no covering mechanism) every retrieval+reconstruction pipeline must return UNKNOWN (or gated confidence<0.80) with UNKNOWN precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10. NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY (ID NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY): Empty registry (N=6) with any intent returns UNKNOWN 100% for all pipelines (validates hierarchical does not hallucinate themes). NC-ORACLE-LEAK (ID NC-ORACLE-LEAK): Audit that derived_context contains only allowed keys (url/method/url_path/url_query/url_segments/headers_observed/body_observed) and hierarchical component extraction uses only template parsing (no access to alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix/target_style/path_style/header_key/body_field/auth_scope/expected_template) and no hard-coded confidence (std>0.05, varies across tasks, gated). Failure of any NC -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. NC-FLAT-COLLAPSE-DIAGNOSTIC (exploratory, not gating): Flat TFIDF/embed top-5 Jaccard overlap among retrieved templates >0.80 on alias-OOD (indicating similarity collapse) - documents the failure mode hierarchical is meant to fix, reported but not gating SURVIVES.
measurement_validity: Registry and fixture reuse for comparability: Reuse byte-identical synthetic fixture from EXP-FRONTIER-35773143736 tasks.json sha 4abf1487 (40 alias-OOD pooled =30 orthogonal 3 families x10 [7 standard +3 held-out] +10 mixed header+body+query co-occurring, 12 exact, 12 no-applicable, 6 empty =70 tasks). Registry per alias-OOD task contains exactly one training mechanism (one alias form at 0.9) + one distractor alias form at 0.9 + one low-confidence distractor at 0.8, all preconditions={} guards={} to isolate aliasing. Test query uses held-out alias form with same semantic intent string as training (intent held equal -> exact matcher failure due to template aliasing requiring reconstruction). Verify 0/40 leakage (no test template verbatim in registry). This substrate is already validated (audit PASS, 40/40 reconstruction 1.0 with exact-intent scan). No new BrowserGym 1280x720 SPAs required per Director rationale (avoids 0/4 envs substrate failure seen in 12 prior live attempts). Holdout integrity preserved: 9 held-out forms (X-Api-Key/X-Auth-Key/Api-Token/api_token/authToken/access_key/permission/access_scope/X-Scope) not in indexer training, mixed 10 compositions held-out from component clustering training (cluster fit on train registry only).

State and component representation - genuine non-oracle: derived_context provided to retriever and reconstruction contains ONLY observation-derived fields from synthetic URL/header/body dict (url, method, url_path, url_query dict, url_segments list, headers_observed dict, body_observed JSON/string). It MUST NOT contain ground-truth fixture signals alias_family, query_key, target_prefix, routing_prefix, target_style, path_style, header_key, body_field, auth_scope, expected_template. Hierarchical component extraction parses each mechanism template string (action_template) to extract url_segments, query_keys, header_keys, body_fields, auth_scopes via deterministic template parsing (regex \$\{[^}]+\} slots + splitting on '/' '?' '&' ':'), never reading hidden_expected. Themes formed by clustering component sets (Jaccard) and majority vote on component type. Retrieval scoring uses only derived_context+intent vs theme centroid (TFIDF/embed), not hidden_expected. Audit verifies no forbidden key reads via code inspection and index manifest contains only allowed parsed components.

Action representation and pipeline isolation: Mechanism action_template is string template with ${slot} parameters in URL path, query param, header value, body JSON field, or auth scope, and for mixed tasks simultaneously header+body+query slots. Binding via deterministic kernel _bind plus header/body field substitution. Reconstruction after retrieval is fixed genuine rule (choose_adoptions + rewrite_template_multi alphabetically-sorted multi-adoption) before _bind, conditioned only on (intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates). Confidence = softmax over candidate scores (temp 0.15) + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80 for ECE. This isolates retrieval effect: any correct_resolution improvement of hierarchical over flat is attributable to candidate diversity (complementarity) not to stronger rewriting, since rewriting is identical across conditions. Harness exposes hierarchical_retrieve(intent, derived_context, registry) -> candidates and flat_retrieve identical signature for audit.

Orthogonal alias families, mixed multi-channel, held-out: Synthetic orthogonal 30 tasks =3 families x10: (a) header-based (ApiKey vs X-Reset-Token vs Authorization Bearer aliasing, held-out X-Api-Key), (b) body JSON field (apiKey vs key vs token, held-out api_token/authToken/access_key), (c) auth permission (scope read vs admin_scope vs permission header, held-out permission/access_scope/X-Scope). Each family 7 standard +3 held-out requiring generalization via key/segment analysis. Report overall 10/family and held-out-9 subset. Mixed 10 tasks where aliasing spans header+body+query within one request (e.g., header X-Api-Key + body api_token + query permission simultaneously aliased), registry training mechanisms are single-channel only; test requires joint multi-field rewriting. Hierarchical themes predicted to retrieve one header-theme + one body-theme + one auth-theme candidate (distinct components) vs flat top-5 retrieving 5 header-only near-duplicates. No AX tree or BrowserGym required; task count 40 pooled primary, 30 orthogonal and 10 mixed diagnostics, held-out 9 diagnostic.

Hierarchical indexing protocol (xMemory-style, deterministic, revisable): Level1 episodes indexed as mechanism documents (intent+template text). Level2 components extracted as sets {header:ApiKey, body:apiKey, ...} per mechanism. Level3 themes via agglomerative clustering with Jaccard threshold 0.6 on component sets, revisable by re-clustering if new mechanism added (disclosed but not exercised in this experiment). Theme centroid computed as mean TFIDF vector or mean embed (MiniLM) of member mechanisms. Query-time: score themes by cosine between query (intent+derived_context serialized as 'intent url_path header_keys body_keys') and theme centroid; rank themes; select themes top-down: start with best theme, expand to next theme only if current selected set uncertainty reduction criterion met: entropy of softmax over current candidate scores >0.4 or distinct component coverage <2 on alias-OOD families. Adaptive k = 2-5 mechanisms sampled complementarily (at least one per selected theme, max 2 per theme). Flat baselines use global top-5 cosine over episodes (no theme diversity). All retrievers deterministic given seed 42.

Determinism and seeds: All RNG via numpy.random.RandomState(seed=42) and Python random.seed(42); deterministic hashing via hashlib.sha256, not Python hash(). TFIDF vectorizer and embedding retriever deterministic normalized embeddings. Hierarchical clustering deterministic (scipy or sklearn with fixed seed). Each task evaluated once per pipeline (paired design); block bootstrap resampling for CIs uses 2000 resamples over tasks grouped by trajectory (here task family, so trajectory-grouped bootstrap respects family structure).

Holdout and leakage controls: All alias families and mixed stratum stratified; train never sees test alias form nor mixed composition (verify 0/40 leakage for pooled, 0/9 for held-out, 0/10 mixed). TF-IDF/embedding fit on train registry only (registry built from training mechanisms). Hierarchical theme centroids fit on train registry only. Reconstruction rule derived from training alias documentation only (choose_adoptions via observed key not in registry). Audit checks no pipeline accesses hidden_expected or test-template verbatim except via derived_context parsing, and hierarchical index manifest audit shows no forbidden keys.

Sample counts (minimum discriminating, substrate-available): Alias-OOD 40 pooled (30 orthogonal +10 mixed) is primary (minimum 32 if mixed partially unavailable with disclosure, but 40 required for beta=0.8 power to detect 0.60 vs 0.10 at n=40 with binomial). Exact-match 12, no-applicable 12, empty-registry 6 =70 per pipeline x7 pipelines =490 calls. Hierarchical indexing is offline (<1 min). No live BrowserGym tasks required; cost is CPU-only. All pipelines evaluated paired per task enabling McNemar. Overall alias-OOD N>=40 required for confirmatory binomial/McNemar power; mixed diagnostic requires N>=10 else downgraded.

Verification, metrics, and retrieval complementarity: correct_resolution = retrieved set contains rewritable candidate and reconstruction binds to expected_bound (hidden_expected_template bound equality including header/body field equality and for mixed all channels jointly correct); false_accept = resolved to wrong template or bound incorrectly or should have abstained; UNKNOWN = correctly abstained when no applicable mechanism or gated confidence<0.80. Retrieval recall@k per task = 1 if retrieved candidates contain at least one mechanism whose template, when rewritten via reconstruction, yields correct bound (component recall). Coverage = mean recall@k over pooled. Coverage gain = hierarchical coverage - best flat coverage. Evidence density = mean distinct semantic components (distinct header_keys+body_fields+auth_scopes) in retrieved set divided by k, averaged over alias-OOD. Evidence density gain = hierarchical density - flat density. Calibration via ECE over 5 confidence bins (confidence derived from reconstruction structural score) plus abstention precision/recall; Wilson 95% CI for rates; one-sided binomial vs 0.10; McNemar paired for hierarchical vs B-EXACT-MATCH (correct) and vs B-VERBATIM-REPLAY (false_accept); block bootstrap 2000 for coverage/density gains and ECE CI, trajectory-grouped by family. Report per-family, held-out-9, mixed-10 breakdowns and adaptive k distribution.

Blinding and oracle prohibition: No pipeline tuned on test alias forms nor mixed compositions; held-out and mixed excluded from theme centroid training and clustering. Derived_context forbidden keys filtered at harness level before retrieve call. Hierarchical component extraction parses only template strings, not hidden_expected metadata. Confidence derivation inspectable (softmax scores visible). Mixed stratum audit verifies reconstruction does not memorize mixed template but composes via adoption. No outcome-bearing measurements during DESIGN.
decision_rule: All primary thresholds on pooled alias-OOD (N=40: 30 orthogonal +10 mixed) unless stated; use Wilson 95% CI, one-sided binomial vs 0.10 null, paired McNemar, block bootstrap 2000 (trajectory-grouped by family). Computations per-pipeline correct_resolution, false_accept, UNKNOWN, coverage, density, ECE over 5 confidence bins (reconstruction-derived) with bootstrap CI. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff ALL hold: (1) PC-EXACT-MATCH passes (all pipelines correct>=0.90 and false<=0.10 on exact-match N=12; hierarchical exact >=0.90 and not >0.10 below B-EXACT-MATCH) and PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH passes (non-empty >=90% and hierarchical distinct coverage >= flat on >=50%) and PC-HIERARCHICAL-INDEX-BUILT passes (>=3 themes >=6 components episode==registry size no leak); (2) NC-NO-APPLICABLE passes (UNKNOWN precision>=0.90 false<=0.10 for all) AND NC-EMPTY 100% AND NC-ORACLE-LEAK passes (no forbidden reads, std>0.05); (3) Alias-OOD pooled S1: H-HIERARCHICAL+recon pooled correct>=0.50 AND binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 AND McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH (expected 0/40) and orthogonal subset >=0.50 and mixed subset >=0.40 diagnostic and held-out 9/9 >=0.50 diagnostic (mixed <0.40 triggers bounded composition note but not auto-fail if pooled passes, mixed <0.30 with pooled <0.50 triggers bounded falsification); (4) S2: hierarchical false_accept<=0.15 AND strictly below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY by >=0.15 absolute with McNemar p<0.05 on false_accept; (5) S3: hierarchical exact-match correct>=0.90 (no regression, not >0.10 below B-EXACT-MATCH); (6) S4: hierarchical no-applicable precision>=0.85 AND ECE<=0.15 (5 bins, derived confidence) with bootstrap CI upper <=0.18; (7) S5 not dominated: hierarchical pooled correct not >0.10 below best flat RAG pooled correct (if best flat is 0/40, hierarchical must be >0); (8) S6 COMPLEMENTARITY: hierarchical coverage gain >=0.15 absolute over best flat (TFIDF-K5 vs EMBED-K5 max) with block bootstrap 95% CI lower >0.05 and p<0.05, AND evidence density gain >0 with bootstrap p<0.05 (hierarchical mean distinct components per retrieved set > flat mean). If S6 fails but S1-S5 pass, result is MIXED: retrieval complementarity not demonstrated despite resolution not regressing - bounded claim to no complementarity advantage. FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls pass but S1 fails (pooled <0.40 or binomial p>=0.05 or McNemar p>=0.05 or orthogonal<0.40) or S2 fails (false>0.25 or not below verbatim) or S6 coverage gain <0.05 non-significant when hierarchical does not beat flat - bounded to hierarchical vs flat on tested orthogonal/mixed synthetic with minimal derived dict. LIVE conditional not applicable (no BrowserGym per Director); claim bounded to synthetic. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any PC/NC fails or pooled N<32 or >20% harness errors or registry leak >0 or hierarchical returns empty >50% or index leak.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES with S1-S6 including complementarity gain >=0.15 and density gain: Decoupling-before-aggregation hierarchical retrieval over SPIDER mechanism registry provides measurable alias-OOD complementarity vs flat top-5 RAG k=5 cosine and verbatim replay on validated orthogonal header/body/auth + mixed splits without BrowserGym. Product should replace flat top-k RAG with hierarchical theme-diversified retrieval before reconstruction: theme centroids (header/body/auth/mixed) with top-down complementary selection expanding only when uncertainty reduces, adaptive k 3-5 maximizing distinct component coverage, followed by genuine reconstruction (choose_adoptions+rewrite_template_multi) and confidence-gated UNKNOWN<0.80 with ECE<=0.15. This addresses flat RAG similarity collapse failure mode (TFIDF/embed 0/40 due to intent-held-equal) and is substrate-available (same registry, no new SPAs, beats Stagehand exact-selector caching baseline conceptually via complementarity not DOM-hash). Justifies promotion to Product Core as retrieval layer with verification boundary and freshness guard; unblocks cross-site parameterized transfer where header/body/auth aliasing is common (directly tests Director's tool/API bypass prior: endpoint+method+auth scope discovery via complementary themes). Next frontier step per Director is WebAPI endpoint+auth-scope mining over this retrieval substrate. C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE advances from EXPERIMENTAL synthetic rule-based to EXPERIMENTAL hierarchical-retrieval complementarity (not yet VALIDATED without live/browser and cost/stability replication).
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (S1 fails hierarchical<0.40 or S6 coverage gain <0.05 non-significant) or MIXED (S1-S5 pass but S6 fails) when hierarchical does not improve over flat or verbatim despite controls passing: Flat top-k similarity limitations are not remedied by theme diversification on tested orthogonal/mixed synthetic with minimal derived dict; retrieval is not the bottleneck (prior 40/40 with exact-intent scan shows reconstruction alone suffices when retrieval is ideal). Product should NOT replace flat RAG with hierarchical theme layer; keep existing retrieval (exact-intent scan or flat RAG when intent differs) and preserve reconstruction proxy as the value-add; prioritize explicit alias catalogs or server-side routing normalization. Close hierarchical retrieval mechanism for these families/compositions; next frontier attack per Director should pivot to orthogonal basin WebAPI endpoint+method+auth scope mining (tool bypass prior) rather than tuning hierarchical thresholds, component Jaccard, or theme counts. C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains EXPERIMENTAL at rule-based reconstruction ceiling (bounded falsification for tested hierarchical retrieval on orthogonal/mixed, not global falsification of all semantic resolution). Sequencing saved BrowserGym cost (no live burn). If MEASUREMENT_INVALID, fix index leakage, clustering, health gates, and re-run without claiming falsification.
estimated_cost: Low substrate-available: 70 synthetic tasks per pipeline x7 pipelines (B-EXACT, B-VERBATIM, B-FLAT-TFIDF-K5, B-FLAT-EMBED-K5, B-FLAT-EMBED-K1, B-RANDOM-K5, H-HIERARCHICAL) =490 kernel resolve+bind+retrieve calls plus hierarchical indexing offline (<2 min CPU for TFIDF/embed centroid + agglomerative clustering). Offline embedding via all-MiniLM-L6-v2 local CPU (~220 encodings per run, <30s). TFIDF fit train only. No Playwright/BrowserGym navigations, no hosted LLM calls/tokens, no new SPA fixtures. Wall-clock <20 min CPU single runner, <5 min without embed model, <1 min indexing. No large datasets committed. If embed unavailable, cost drops to <10 min with TFIDF only and disclosed.
expected_information_gain: Very high with minimal cost and no infra risk: First falsifiable test of Director's comparative reasoning pivot - whether hierarchical decoupling-before-aggregation (xMemory episode->component->theme, revisable grouping, top-down complementary selection expanding only when uncertainty reduces) remedies flat top-5 RAG similarity collapse on bounded coherent streams with near-duplicate intents that directly maps to SPIDER's flat RAG/replay baselines and Stagehand DOM-hash validation limits (structural not semantic drift) - on the same validated synthetic orthogonal header/body/auth alias-OOD splits (40 pooled 30+10 mixed 9 held-out, audit PASS 40/40 reconstruction) that frontier already closed synthetic tuning on. Tests whether retrieval, not reconstruction, is bottleneck to beating Stagehand exact-selector caching (2x speedup/30% cost as strong baseline SPIDER must beat per Scout brief) and to realizing tool/API bypass via endpoint+auth scope discovery, without chasing the BrowserGym 0/0 health 0/4 envs substrate that prior 12 live attempts showed invalid (portfolio assessment). Either outcome changes product/architecture: positive (S1-S6 coverage gain >=0.15) validates retrieval complementarity gain and evidence density as orthogonal mechanism to reconstruction (1.0 already optimal) and justifies hierarchical retrieval promotion before next frontier WebAPI mining; negative (hierarchical <= flat) falsifies theme-diversity hypothesis for these families and cleanly parks retrieval complementarity while preserving bounded 40/40 reconstruction ceiling, forcing pivot to WebAPI mining per allocation comparative_reasoning with saved live burn (high information per cost). Strong baselines (exact, verbatim, flat TFIDF/embed k=5 vs k=1, random), PC/NC with calibration gates (UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, ECE<=0.15, NC-ORACLE-LEAK), channel-isolation (header-only 20/40 body-only 10/40 url-only 0/40) and trajectory-grouped block bootstrap plus per-family/held-out/mixed breakdowns ensure result not explained by retrieval luck, hardness collapse, or reconstruction memorization. Orthogonal to 30+ prior freshness/PMI/TV loops (frontier charter to leave solution basin) and to exhaustive runtime 44-deep tunnel, respecting global direction discipline (SUPERSEDE not CONTINUE). Reports complementarity gain, density, k adaptivity, and verification economics vs RAG/verbatim for product decision.
